major_cooldowns.name: Recklessness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown and lean on Rampage while it runs, since Recklessness slashes its rage cost and turns Bloodthirst and Raging Blow into Bloodbath and Crushing Blow.

major_cooldowns.name: Avatar
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Macro it to Recklessness, since Anger Management shortens both and they line up on their own.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 107574 was not pressed in the sampled parses, which are Slayer builds; it is castable per its tooltip and the guide names it as the Mountain Thane cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Bladestorm
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Open it while Enraged and right after a Rampage, and bank it for the next Recklessness window when Recklessness is close to ready.
major_cooldowns.id_note: The guide links Bladestorm(spell=227847), but 446035 is the id recorded for every sampled parse's casts and its own self aura; the table gives both a 90s base cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Odyn's Fury
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown for the free Enrage, and as Mountain Thane fire it before you open the rest of your cooldowns so the window stays uncluttered.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 385060 is the cast id in all five sampled parses; 385059 is the tooltip row carrying the 45s base cooldown.

rule.description: Keep Enrage up between Rampage casts
rule.action: Cast Rampage as Enrage is about to expire so it never drops.

rule.description: Rampage at high rage, not the instant it is castable
rule.action: Weave Bloodthirst and Raging Blow in and hold Rampage for a near-full rage bar or an expiring Enrage.

rule.description: Rampage fills the rotation during Recklessness
rule.action: Press Rampage between your Bloodbath casts while Recklessness is up, since its rage cost is cut there.

rule.description: Spend Sudden Death procs on Execute
rule.action: Fire Execute as soon as Sudden Death lights up, at any boss health.

rule.description: Execute takes over your fillers in execute range
rule.action: Send Execute ahead of Bloodthirst and Raging Blow once the boss falls into execute range.

rule.description: Hold Bladestorm when Recklessness is nearly ready
rule.action: Bank Bladestorm and open it inside the Recklessness window instead of just before it.
Macro Avatar to Recklessness so Anger Management keeps the two windows stacked.
